The '''Rullag system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Rullag]] was located in this system.<ref name="GP4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rullag system was established in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], which placed the system in grid square T-8.
